plainTranslation: A's feelings meets B's dreams. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your imagination, hope, and idealism. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The difficulty is that this connection can sometimes stay in the realm of potential. Both people may sense what the other is feeling without ever talking about it directly. Important needs can remain implied rather than expressed. The relationship may feel warm and supportive, yet avoid the conversations that would allow it to deepen further.
advice: This aspect works best when intuition is paired with honesty. Trust what you sense, but also say what you mean. The compassion between you is real, but it becomes much more meaningful when it is supported by clear communication. The gift here is not saving each other. It is creating a relationship where both people feel understood, cared for, and free to remain themselves.
summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your imagination, hope, and idealism.
